## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] The unpacked extension reloads without errors
- [ ] Changed side-panel flows were smoke-tested in Chrome/Chromium
- [ ] Manifest and package versions match when preparing a release

## Security impact

Note changes to permissions, host access, stored secrets, request mutation, or
proxy behaviour. Write `None` if there is no security impact.
